d:
A BSF jawan was detained by Bangladesh's Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) after accidentally crossing the international border in Meghalaya on November 17. According to reports, the jawan was chasing suspected smugglers when he entered Bangladesh's Sylhet district through an unfenced stretch of the border. Following talks and a flag meeting between BSF and BGB officials, he was safely handed back to India the same evening. How did the incident happen, and how was the jawan brought back?
